name: Block Points
description: A coin-age reward vault. Tokens deposited into the shared BlockPoints vault can be claimed by anyone, at one token per BCH per block that their coin has been held unmoved. The vault releases the BPTS reward token at vox.cash/bpt, and works for any fungible token.

funder.name: Funder
funder.description: Deposits tokens into the vault as a new thread, to be claimed by coin holders. The deposit cannot be taken back.

claimant.name: Claimant
claimant.description: Claims tokens from a vault thread, proportional to the value and age of one of their own coins.

fundThread.name: Fund a vault thread
fundThread.description: Deposit $(<threadTokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) into the BlockPoints vault. Anyone holding BCH can then claim them, one token per BCH per block of coin age. Nobody can take them back.

funder.name: Fund a vault thread
funder.description: Choose the token category and amount, and the satoshis the thread holds (about 800).

claim.name: Claim Block Points
claim.description: Claim $(claimReward) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) from a vault thread, for holding a coin of $(<claimantCoinSatoshis>) satoshis for $(<age>) blocks.

claimant.name: Claim
claimant.description: Pick one of your plain BCH coins and one vault thread. The age is the number of blocks since the younger of the two was mined (at most 65535). The reward is age × coin value / 100,000,000.

fundThreadTransaction.name: Vault thread funded
fundThreadTransaction.description: $(<threadTokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) were deposited into the BlockPoints vault.

claimTransaction.name: Block Points claimed
claimTransaction.description: $(claimReward) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) were claimed for a coin of $(<claimantCoinSatoshis>) satoshis held $(<age>) blocks.

claimantCoinInput.name: Your aged coin
claimantCoinInput.description: A plain BCH coin of yours, unmoved for at least $(<age>) blocks. It is spent and comes back as change, less the fee.

vaultInput.name: Vault thread
vaultInput.description: A BlockPoints vault thread at least $(<age>) blocks old.

vaultThreadOutput.name: Vault thread
vaultThreadOutput.description: $(<threadTokenAmount>) tokens of category $(<tokenCategory>) in the BlockPoints vault.

vaultReturnOutput.name: Vault thread (after the claim)
vaultReturnOutput.description: The thread, back in the vault with the reward taken out.

vaultLockingScript.name: BlockPoints vault
vaultLockingScript.description: The shared BlockPoints vault. Tokens here can only be released to coin holders, a little per block.

scripts.checkClaim: <age> OP_1 <maximumAge> OP_1ADD OP_WITHIN OP_VERIFY claimReward OP_0 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY claimReward <vaultTokenAmount> OP_LESSTHAN OP_VERIFY

satoshisPerCoin.name: Satoshis per coin
satoshisPerCoin.description: One token per 100,000,000 satoshis (1 BCH) per block.

maximumAge.name: Maximum age
maximumAge.description: The largest age a claim can use, in blocks: 65535, the largest block-based relative timelock.

rewardOutputSatoshis.name: Reward output satoshis
rewardOutputSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by the reward output, as vox.cash/bpt does. They come from the claimant’s coin.

tokenCategory.name: Token category
tokenCategory.description: The category of the vault thread’s token (BPTS on vox.cash/bpt), as hex.

threadTokenAmount.name: Tokens to deposit
threadTokenAmount.description: How many tokens the new thread holds.

threadSatoshis.name: Thread satoshis
threadSatoshis.description: Satoshis the new thread holds (about 800). A claimer could take part of them: the contract does not check them.

vaultTokenAmount.name: Thread token amount
vaultTokenAmount.description: How many tokens the vault thread being claimed from holds now.

vaultSatoshis.name: Thread satoshis
vaultSatoshis.description: The satoshis in the vault thread being claimed from.

claimantCoinSatoshis.name: Your coin’s value
claimantCoinSatoshis.description: The value in satoshis of the coin you claim with. The contract reads it from input 0.

age.name: Age in blocks
age.description: Blocks since the younger of your coin and the vault thread was mined, from 1 to 65535.

rewardLockingScript.name: Reward address
rewardLockingScript.description: The token-aware locking script that receives the claimed tokens.

resources.name: Original BlockPoints contract
resources.description: The vault script by 2qx, hand-written CashASM in the Libauth template v3.2 (Unlicense). This template uses it verbatim.

resources.name: vox.cash/bpt
resources.description: The Block Points web app by 2qx, with the BPTS vault and claim flow.

resources.name: Template and tests
resources.description: This template, the verbatim upstream script and the tests that tie it to the live vault address.
